title: Cross-Chain Payer Reconciliation: EVM Transfer Sender vs Solana SPL Associated Token Account
common_agent_failure: Agent compares reported Solana wallet authority directly against the raw SPL transferChecked source token account (ATA) and falsely flags a valid settled payment as a payer mismatch.
required_unknowns_preserved: An SPL transfer source is a token account rather than the wallet authority; owner resolution is required before asserting payer identity.
